title: Project02 character package descriptor
description: Authoring schema for project02.character.json. Mirrors the runtime validator (src/characters/api/package-descriptor.ts); intentionally strict about unknown keys so typos surface while editing. tests/unit/character-package-schema.test.ts keeps this file honest against the code validator.

id.description: Stable character id; must equal the package folder name. Permanent once a store is bound to it.

displayName.description: Speaker name stamped on the character's messages. Renaming affects new sessions only; existing sessions keep their historical name.

items.description: One persona section rendered into the system frame, in order. Persona only — runtime protocol text is not overridable.

version.description: Semantic version of the character content; recorded in turn evidence.

plugins.description: Plugins this character expects: required ids block activation when missing or disabled, recommended ids warn, config seeds per-plugin defaults into the character overlay on first selection.
